title: Older tech workers are retiring at 55. But claiming Social Security early offers smaller checks for life.
title_zh: 年长的科技工作者将在 55 岁退休。但提前领取社会保障可以提供较小的终身支票。
summary: Whether you choose to retire early or are pushed out by layoffs, it takes careful planning. Here’s what you need to know.
summary_zh: 无论您选择提前退休还是因裁员而被淘汰，都需要仔细规划。这是您需要了解的内容。

title: IREN (NasdaqGS:IREN) Lands Microsoft And Nvidia Deals As AI Data Center Expansion Grows
title_zh: 随着人工智能数据中心扩张的不断发展，IREN (NasdaqGS:IREN) 与微软和 Nvidia 达成交易
summary: IREN (NasdaqGS:IREN) has shifted its focus toward building large scale data centers for artificial intelligence workloads. The company recently signed new long term infrastructure contracts with Microsoft and Nvidia tied to AI capacity.
summary_zh: IREN（纳斯达克股票代码：IREN）已将重点转向为人工智能工作负载构建大型数据中心。该公司最近与微软和英伟达签署了与人工智能能力相关的新的长期基础设施合同。

title: Lenovo (SEHK:992) Expands Hybrid AI Offerings And Launches Tab Plus Gen 2
title_zh: 联想 (SEHK:992) 扩展混合人工智能产品并推出 Tab Plus Gen 2
summary: Lenovo Group (SEHK:992) expanded its Hybrid AI Advantage portfolio with new AI inferencing solutions and platforms for hybrid deployment. The company announced fresh collaborations with NVIDIA, Intel, Red Hat, and Canonical to support enterprise AI workloads.
summary_zh: 联想集团（SEHK：992）通过新的人工智能推理解决方案和混合部署平台扩展了其混合人工智能优势产品组合。该公司宣布与 NVIDIA、Intel、Red Hat 和 Canonical 开展新合作，以支持企业 AI 工作负载。

title: Does KKR’s (KKR) India Hospital Deal And Fee Shift Reveal A New Earnings Playbook?
title_zh: KKR (KKR) 印度医院交易和费用调整是否揭示了新的盈利策略？
summary: KKR recently entered advanced talks to acquire Sweden-based Medicover’s 66.9% stake in its Indian hospital business for at least US$1.05 billion, while also reporting quarter-to-date monetization income above US$900 million, mostly from realized performance fees.
summary_zh: KKR 最近进入高级谈判，以至少 10.5 亿美元收购总部位于瑞典的 Medicover 在其印度医院业务中 66.9% 的股份，同时报告本季度迄今的货币化收入超过 9 亿美元，其中大部分来自已实现的绩效费用。
